name: ravensight
description: Set up Ravensight, connect your agent, instrument your game and use studio evidence. Playtesting is separate.

defaultPrompt: Help me set up Ravensight for this game.
Use my Ravensight studio evidence to plan the next improvement.
interface.longDescription: Guides game developers through Ravensight setup, SDK instrumentation and evidence-based studio workflows. Includes five agent skills and the public documentation MCP. Account-specific analytics require a separate authorized studio connection; no account credentials are bundled. Playtesting is optional and installed separately. The skills explain consent, scoped credentials and usage limits without automatically granting access or starting paid work.
